cvStructure.issue: Your CV has no dedicated Skills section, even though you use tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana, Ansible and Helm throughout your experience and projects.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a Skills section (for example after your Summary) that lists these tools directly, so an ATS scanning for cloud and DevOps keywords can find them.

keywordUsage.issue: In the Junior DevOps Engineer entry, "Kubernets" is misspelled and "Git Hub Actions" and "Terrafrom" are not written in their official forms.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Write these as Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and Terraform to match their official names.

readability.issue: The Cloud Operations Intern bullets "Monitoring", "Server stuff and deployments" and "Helping with tickets" are vague duty labels rather than action statements, and none show a result.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite each as a short point starting with a strong verb, such as "Monitored [systems] to catch [type of issue]" or "Resolved [number] support tickets related to [topic]", adding a result where you can.

readability.issue: The Graduation project entry is written as a first-person story ("I worked on the servers part with my team and it was successful") with no specific result.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite it as a short point starting with a verb, for example "Configured the server infrastructure for [project name], achieving [result or metric]".

contentFormatting.issue: Your Summary states "over 3 years of professional experience", but your listed roles (Jun 2025 - Aug 2025 internship and Mar 2026 - Present job) add up to under a year.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Update the Summary to match your actual experience length, for example "DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience building and running cloud infrastructure on AWS".

contentFormatting.issue: The Self-hosted Git server project shows only a year, "(2025)", while every other date in your CV uses a month and year format.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Add the month, for example "[Month] 2025", so all dates follow the same Mon YYYY format.
